doc.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Big band drumming and the Monday night band at Pearl's
summary: Big band skills came from casuals; he now plays the Monday Night Big Band with Thad Jones and Oliver Nelson charts.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Do you consider yourself a big band drummer?

Yeah. I mean actually I did it, I mean that was part of my experience and training coming up, and a lot of the gigs we did, casuals or club dates, had to do with big bands, so that was a skill that was valuable. And I sort of spent some time at it. And then I didn’t do it for a long time, there weren’t any gigs and I stopped making rehearsal bands and stuff like that. And then this club Pearl’s where I work has a Monday Night Big Band and I used to sub in that once in a while. And now I’m kind of doing it on a regular basis. I’m really enjoying it. Of course the band plays a lot of Thad Jones material and Oliver Nelson material, and Frank Foster and stuff like that so it’s all fun to play. And I guess because I’ve been doing it a long time and I’m just better at it, at least I think so.
